rationale: A clear single-attestation destruction formula; lookup found no separate existing loḥe collocation. Index it as a phrase while keeping lexical sense 1.

summary: The active Infectum supplies a missing box without introducing a new lexical sense. The source already has an active destruction event and a Detransitive written-deletion predicate.
In 104/3 mi arʕo marks the domain from which the name is removed; it is not an agent. The phrase belongs in Idiomatic phrases rather than a new numbered sense.
Annihilation extends from insect destruction to erasing a state's name; the named entity is fronted and its name is the direct object.
